design.service: PP melt-spin staple-fiber line: pellet -> spun fiber -> needle-punched nonwoven fleece for the crew textile issue
design.basis: A-M-429; A-M-225 (the FR finish rides the D-DOCK reagent manifest, the WS_SOLV reagent-import class)
design.fr_finish: phosphorus-FR finish at the ~2 % pick-up class: PP is inherently flammable, the FR finish is the wool-flammability replacement carrier
design.product: fleece to MFG_SHOP for conversion (cutting/sewing/knitting) - the shop issues finished textiles to the hab
design.feed: draws the C5-C10 export surplus: IA-C5-SHIP gives up the 0.09 kg/d polymer share (the export carried 7.13 kg/d)
design.waste: spin scrap returns to the solids/leach line (POLY_TO_WET class: PP is leach-inert)

nozzles.service: PP pellet draw to the melt-spin line
spin scrap to the solids line
FR-finished fleece to the shop for conversion

material: SS304 melt vessel and spin pump with heater bands, brass-free spinnerette (stainless die plate), PP quench ducting
